title: Representative: Read-only Front Desk role — view WO/Customers/Schedule, no edits, no financials
permission: WO View + Customers View + Schedule View, no create/edit/delete, financials OFF
preconditions: Logged in as an Administrator with full access. Application is on the Custom Roles & Permissions build (Epic SV-7388, SV-7500 enabled). At least one test staff member exists to receive the role. A second browser/session is available to log in as the test staff user.
role_setup: ON: Work Orders > View; Customers > View; Schedule > View. OFF: everything else — no WO Edit/Delete, no WO Lines, no Customers Edit/Delete, no Schedule Edit/Delete, See Financial Data OFF, Invoicing OFF, Parts Department OFF, Part Sales OFF, Catalog OFF, Vendor OFF, Reports OFF, Timesheets OFF, History Logs OFF, Settings OFF, App Settings OFF, View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF. View Mode = Full (UX only).
test_data: Test staff user 'frontdesk_qa'. One existing work order, one customer, one schedule entry.

steps.action: Navigate Settings > Roles & Permissions (avatar menu → Settings → Roles & Permissions; URL /administration/roles-permissions) > Create Custom Role. Start from a blank/minimal baseline (all toggles OFF). Name the role 'Read-only Front Desk'. (Step 1 is a 'Choose a template' dialog with Skip / Apply; the footer save button on the Create Role page is labelled 'Create'.)
steps.expected: Create Custom Role form opens with every permission toggle OFF by default. Role name accepted.

steps.action: Enable only Work Orders > View, Customers > View, Schedule > View. Leave all else OFF.
steps.expected: The three View toggles turn ON. No cascade fires (View has no lower dependency). No financial modal appears (no financial-gated CRUD enabled).

steps.action: Save the role, then go Administration > Staff > open the test user > assign role 'Read-only Front Desk' > Create.
steps.expected: Role saved with exactly the configured toggles. Staff assignment saved. A role change forces the affected user to be logged out.

steps.action: In a separate browser, log in as the test staff user.
steps.expected: Login succeeds; the user sees only navigation permitted by the assigned role.

steps.action: POSITIVE: Open Work Orders, Customers, and Schedule from nav.
steps.expected: All three areas open in read-only mode; records are visible.

steps.action: POSITIVE: Attempt to find create/edit/delete controls in WO, Customers, Schedule.
steps.expected: No Add/Edit/Delete/Save actions are available; data is view-only.

steps.action: NEGATIVE (aggregate): Check nav for Invoicing, Parts, Catalog, Vendor, Reports, Timesheets, History Logs, Administration, and any financial figures.
steps.expected: All ungranted nav items are hidden/blocked. No financial data (prices, totals, costs) is displayed anywhere.

expected_final: User can only view Work Orders, Customers, and Schedule. All other areas hidden, no edit capability, no financial data visible. Access equals exactly the granted union.
source_viu: Spec: SV-7388 role matrix; CRUD cascade & financial-gate rules. UNVERIFIED — VIU pending.
